Artist Unknown
Gemstone Bonsai Wire Tree
Wire and Gemstone Sculpture on Quartz Base
9" L x 4" W x 9" H
Unsigned
This elegant gemstone bonsai tree sculpture features intricate gold-toned wire branches adorned with polished crystal chips in white and peach hues. The branches are hand-twisted and set into a substantial raw quartz crystal base, creating a balance between craft and natural mineral beauty. Often associated with Feng Shui for attracting positive energy, this piece serves as a sophisticated accent for bohemian or mid-century modern interiors.
Hand-twisted gold-tone wire construction allowing for custom branch positioning
Features tumbled gemstone chips including clear quartz and peach-toned stones
Substantial raw quartz crystal base provides stability and natural aesthetic appeal
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The wire branches are flexible and intact with no broken segments. The gemstone chips are securely attached, though natural variations in the raw quartz base are present as intended by the artist.
